tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po'i gsung rab glegs bam dang po las dpal ldan bi rū pa la bstod pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// namobi rūpāya/ ahosār+dhañjoprapañcādīr+thaṃ/ pratedzodīp+tāshayātītashrī/ ༄༅// na mo bi rū pā ya/ a la la ste lhan skyes spros bral las// 'di 'dra'i rab brjid dpal 'bar bsam las 'das// ༄༅// birūpetir+yat+sabhaṭ+ṭārakyaḥ aho.asmas+yashriyesaṃbhūtaḥ/ ༄༅// gang de rje btsun bi rū pa zhes pa// bdag gi dpal du gyur pa e ma ho// khyod kyi gzi yis rtog pa kun bral te// sgo gsum rlung rnams dga' ba bzhi rgyas nas// za zi las kyang bde stong gyur nas ni// sangs nas rjes dran cung zad bstod par gyur// bde legs phun tshogs don gnyis 'byor ba'i dpal// mkhyen dang brtse bas skal ldan gdul bya la// lam mchog bstan nas myang 'das la 'god pa// mi g.yo'i mchog tu rol la mgos phyag 'tshal// gang zhig 'jig rten 'dir ni rgyal rigs las// rab byung rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin te// gnas rigs dge 'dun bye bas legs bsten pa// gnas brtan chos skyong grags la mgos phyag 'tshal// bslab gsum don ldan shing rta chen po'i gzhung*// smra ba'i dbang phyug rgol bas mi rdzi bas// bstan pa'i srog shing thams cad mkhyen gnyis par// sa steng rtsod pa med la mgos phyag 'tshal// kun nas 'dus pa'i tshogs la nyin bzhin du// theg rim chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim mdzad nas// mtshan mor gsang spyod bsgrubs pas rnam grol te// bdag med kyis bzung sa drug gyur la 'dud// brtul zhugs spyod pas 'gro rnams drang ba'i phyir// dge 'dun gnas nas dman pa'i spyod pa yis// grong bzhud kun du rgyu bas 'jig rten du// kun gyis bir+war grags la mgos phyag 'tshal// gad+gā bzlog cing ma rungs rgyal po btul// nyi ma bzung nas yul khams myos byed gsol// myos min liṅga rab bkas gtum mo btul// mthu stobs dbang phyug grags la mgos phyag 'tshal// de ltar dpag yas nus bstan de yi mthar// sau rāṣ+ṭar karti ka btul te// dmigs med thugs rjes mkha' dbyings kun khyab pa'i// zung 'jug bde chen rol la mgos phyag 'tshal// chos rnams bde stong shin du rnam dag pa'i// de nyid kho na myur du rtogs byed thabs// snyan brgyud bzhi yis zab mo'i lam bstan nas// skal ldan smin sgrol mdzad la mgos phyag 'tshal// e ma bdag yid dag pa'i dbyings// rnam grol go 'phang ma thob par// rje btsun khyod nyid mngon sum du// 'di ltar yang yang gzung du gsol// de ltar khyed kyi thugs rje yi// shugs las byung ba de dag gi

/bdud rtsi'i rgyun yang spel bgyid na// don yang phun tshogs mdzad du gsol// rjes su slob pa gang rnams kyang*// rim pa gnyis dang mi 'bral zhing*// lam gyi gegs dang mi ldan par// bstan la phan par mdzad du gsol// kun nas dag pa'i sgo gsum rlung*// dga' ba bzhi yis rab rgyas te// snying po 'gros bzhi thim gyur nas// rdo rje 'dzin dbang thob par shog /nye bar bsten pa'i gnas 'di yang*// grags pas sa dang mkha' khyab nas// zla ba ku mud ltar skya pa'i// dge ba'i dpal gyis rol par mdzod// rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po nyid sa dkar po rgyab yol gyi tshul/ 'bal grog mon grog gi bar skyil krung gis khebs par mdzad/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ g.yas su nag po pa/ g.yon du ga ya dha ra/ rgyab tu ko ka li pa/ mdun du bi na sa dang bcas te mngon sum du zhal gzigs/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs/ lam sbas bshad/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi dbang*/ rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi lung*/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i man ngag grub chen bcu/ phra mo brgyad dang bcas pa rnams gsungs pa'i dus/ sa chen gyis bstod pa'i tshig nyams kyi shugs las byung ba/ sa māp+ta mi thi// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
